description:
Activate Myr Turbine's first ability by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
The Myr enters the battlefield, triggering Symmetry Matrix.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Myr, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Symmetry Matrix ability, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Myr Turbine.
Repeat.
